messages:
Jin W: Anyone seen redwoodctl fail on M1 mac with macOS security popup blocking the daemon socket after install?
Marco: Not exactly, paste the error.
Jin W: When I run `redwoodctl local-serve --profile demo` it exits: `listen unix /tmp/redwood-serve.sock: bind: operation not permitted`. mac showed a System Extension/Privacy dialog during install I dismissed.
Ivy M: dismissing the dialog could block our per-user socket shim (we install a small helper). On M1/monterey+ Gatekeeper can prevent creation of sockets in /tmp from apps without user approval.
Jin W: Workaround I found: `sudo xattr -r -d com.apple.quarantine /usr/local/lib/redwood` then restart the helper and `rm /tmp/redwood-serve.sock` and retry. But that's awful to tell users.
Marco: ouch. Installer should request the gatekeeper prompt explicitly (or use a non-protected socket path under user homedir) instead of leaving it to chance.
Lena R: Also saw a confusing profile collision: `redwoodctl init` created a "default" and "demo" profile with identical endpoints, and `redwoodctl login --profile demo` ended up pinging the default profile's CA when the demo profile was supposed to be isolated. It looked like a merge bug in config write.
Ivy M: That explains a lot. So some users get cert errors because login uses the wrong profile endpoint/CA. Could be a race when installer writes configs while local-serve creates the socket.
Jin W: The auth retry behavior didn't help either: CLI fails after 2 quick attempts, but our SDK would retry for ~20s and succeed on flaky networks. Workshops hit both issues.
Marco: Action items: 1) Installer: avoid quarantine-silent paths; add explicit gatekeeper step or use $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/redwood/socket. 2) Config write: ensure atomic profile writes (write tmp then mv) to avoid merges. 3) CLI: align auth retry/backoff with SDK defaults.
DevEx Bot: created DEVEX-1991 "installer(mac): handle macOS quarantine/gatekeeper for redwoodctl helper; use user runtime dir socket by default" (priority=P2)
Lena R: I'll add a quick onboarding note: if you see `bind: operation not permitted` try removing quarantine attrs or use `--socket-path ~/Library/Containers/redwood.sock` and `redwoodctl local-serve --socket-path` for now.
Ivy M: I'll pick up the atomic config write fix and add a unit test simulating concurrent writes. Marco: can you own the socket-path change in installer?
Marco: Yep, will open PR and add an e2e that runs installer on macOS github runner with quarantine simulation. ETA two days.
Jin W: Thanks all, with the socket workaround and forcing longer auth retries my demo VM is back to green. Closing my loop for now :rocket:
